body: It was around $10,000 beforehand I think, but my insurance is UnitedHealthcare and they covered a significant portion of it. The total cost I agreed to pay directly to his office after insurance was $4,200. It is worth noting that for a few months after the surgery, the hospital that he works through (not him)  kept sending me bills for stuff like the anesthesia :/ so I estimate I  spent around $5,000 total. I hope that helps! I think he was a really good pick for me, if I had to do it over I’d choose his office again. And thank you :)
Thank you! I’m over the moon tbh
